question: Should OpenClaw accept this narrow currentTokenCount ContextEngine.assemble API now, or fold token headroom into the broader assemble metadata design tracked by #82137?
rationale: The patch is plausible and useful, but it changes a public plugin SDK contract and overlaps an open RFC for broader assemble metadata, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape.

options.title: Accept narrow API after proof
options.body: Approve currentTokenCount as a small optional assemble field once the SDK baseline and real behavior proof are added.

options.title: Fold into #82137
options.body: Pause or close this PR and handle token counts together with provenance, internal event, and prePrompt metadata in the broader RFC design.

options.title: Request a different contract
options.body: Ask for an alternate API shape before any baseline regeneration or live proof work continues.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow API after proof
recommendation.body: Approve currentTokenCount as a small optional assemble field once the SDK baseline and real behavior proof are added.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to this PR and recently merged adjacent context-engine assemble budgeting work.
